purpose: Determine whether confirm19 S2/eager mismatch traces reflect receiver-output instability, input mutation, or only deadline cutoff behavior.

selection_source.selection_rule: All eight S2/eager correctness mismatch indices from the frozen confirm19 campaign; no mismatch is omitted.

radio.frozen_input: Recreate the declared trace once, copy its GPU tensor, and restore an exact copy before each tested order.

checks: whether either receiver mutates the input tensor
whether receiver order changes conventional output
